suggestions.text: Priya said developers spend about 30% of their time on models, with the rest on negotiating land leases, interconnection and offtake contracts. That suggests the role is primarily commercial deal-making rather than modeling; the exact split may vary across developers or projects.

Cascade developers are mostly based in Denver or Boulder, but two work remotely from Durango. So a mountain-town location is possible at this employer, though it appears to be the exception; it’s still unclear whether remote work is available to new hires or interns.
Cascade usually hires two MBA interns and makes its decision by mid-January.
